 Crist leads St. Pete mayor’s race
 Crist holds a commanding lead in early election results.     .   St. Petersburg mayoral candidate Charlie Crist does an interview with his phone surrounded by supporters, staff and fiancé Chelsea Grimes (right) at the Coliseum on Election Day Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026 in St. Petersburg. [ MARTHA ASENCIO-RHINE | Times ] Colleen Wright is a reporter covering St. Petersburg. She can be reached at cwright@tampabay.com.
